mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate economic weakness and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0, or rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP (GDPC1 < 18000) and housing starts (HOUST < 1250) indicate broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as market sentiment deteriorates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, industrial production above 105.0 signals robust manufacturing activity, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained corporate profitability.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion with INDPRO > 105.0, or rank IC over 3-year windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to immediate monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Residential mortgage sales exceeding 500,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 500000) indicate strong housing demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as housing sector growth supports broader economic expansion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 500000, or rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 150,000 thousand persons (PAYEMS > 150000) signals robust labor market conditions, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending and corporate revenue growth accelerate.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000, or rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 250.0 (CPIAUCSL > 250.0) signals persistent inflationary pressures, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in central bank tightening risks.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250.0, or rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.03.
